_comment: Tier-2: the BDF2 wave scheme ShallowWaterResidualBasedBDFScheme needs SetBufferSize(3), and the time loop must not solve until the buffer is full. Pitfall (kratos.shallow_water #5). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The scheme class resolves on ShallowWaterApplication and not on core. The buffer requirement is pinned by construction: a ModelPart accepts SetBufferSize(3) and reports GetBufferSize()==3, while the default buffer a fresh part carries is smaller — solving at step 1 with a default buffer reads a zero-filled history slot, which is the corruption the claim describes and which raises nothing. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass. INDEX RENUMBERED 5 -> 3: guidance entries were moved out of kratos.shallow_water's pitfalls list, which shifted the indices of the entries after them. The claim this fixture verifies is unchanged.
